gpu_policy: GPU0 only; GPU1 intentionally unused during single-T4 headroom qualification
root_cause: Single-T4 pipeline has insufficient residual VRAM for an eager Higgs codec decode allocation on some utterance lengths after full warmup/reference use.
decision: Do not continue stress testing on 1xT4. Proceed to T4x2 stage placement, keeping the TTS engine on GPU0 and moving audio encoder/vocoder to GPU1 before considering tensor parallelism.
